records.trigger: Four checks pass without protecting anything: orphan validation-protocol smoke, membership smoke blind to real inventory, RED guard blind to finding-fix commits, cross-host review dropping host B findings (B-a745 F-002, F-012 and implementer reports).
records.observedFailure: On the baseline: node packages/main/dist/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.js fails at the CASE_MISMATCH assertion with undefined and no inventory references it; full-suite-runner-smoke evaluates only synthetic fixtures so removing a real RESOURCE_POLICY row does not fail it; the RED guard regex in validation-tier-planner-smoke matches only CHK ids so a squashed RED(F-nnn) passes; cross-host-review persists only stdoutDigest and findingCount so host B finding text is lost.
records.note: Per-item RED commits carry the finer-grained red evidence for the other three smokes.
